title: Danish privacy activist Lars Andersen raided by police
summary: Danish privacy activist Lars Andersen was raided by police, sparking debate about government surveillance and privacy rights in Europe. The incident highlights growing tensions between civil liberties advocates and authorities over data protection enforcement.
problem_solved: Not applicable - this is a news event reporting on a legal/political incident, not a technical solution.
